# Artwork and future media

**No images are missing.** All launch artwork, glass texture sources, procedural previews, particle numerals, favicon and stickers are included or generated by code. You can publish this version immediately after device checks without supplying screenshots.

The current preview graphics are labelled **Original concept artwork**. They do not pretend to be real app screenshots. FitTrack90 is developed; the other two apps are planned concepts.

## Real app media you can add later

Put these in the **source project's `public/media/` folder**, then run `npm run build` or let the included GitHub Actions workflow rebuild. Missing files use the original artwork, without making requests to nonexistent images. File names are lowercase and case-sensitive.

| Exact filename            | Format and suggested size                                                                      | Used for                                                                     |
| ------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `fittrack90-screen.webp`  | WebP, 1080 × 1920 portrait, sRGB, preferably under 400 KB                                      | Real FitTrack90 screenshot inside the glass preview and dialog               |
| `fittrack90-demo.mp4`     | H.264 MP4, 720 × 1280 or 1080 × 1920, 24/30 FPS, 5–12 seconds, no audio, preferably under 3 MB | Muted hover video inside the 3D capsule; user-controlled video in its dialog |
| `vaultledger-screen.webp` | Same portrait WebP specification                                                               | Add only when real product artwork or a screenshot is ready                  |
| `vaultledger-demo.mp4`    | Same MP4 specification                                                                         | Optional future preview                                                      |
| `mindlock-screen.webp`    | Same portrait WebP specification                                                               | Optional future screenshot                                                   |
| `mindlock-demo.mp4`       | Same MP4 specification                                                                         | Optional future preview                                                      |

You may provide only a screenshot, only a video, or both. Videos pause when they are not hovered, when motion is paused or when the tab is inactive. If autoplay is rejected, the artwork/screenshot remains. Dialog video has native playback controls. The glass surface applies an artistic mapping; the dialog presents the complete original image or video without cropping.

To discover new assets during local development, restart `npm run dev`. To update a compiled ZIP deployment, rebuild and upload the new `dist/` contents. Copying a newly named image into an already-built site will not change its compiled media manifest.

To launch the actual Play link, change the FitTrack90 entry in `src/config/site.js`:

```js
preview: 'https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=YOUR_REAL_PACKAGE',
previewLabel: 'View on Google Play',
stage: 'Available on Google Play',
note: 'Available now on Google Play.',
```

Use your real application identifier; the example above is not a working listing. The developed/planned status and factual metrics should change only when the product state changes.

## Included stickers and artwork

| File under `public/`       | Specification                                              | How to replace it                                                                   |
| -------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `stickers/orbit-seal.svg`  | Vector, 240 × 240 viewBox, circular cobalt/white type seal | Replace with your own self-contained SVG using the same filename                    |
| `stickers/chrome-star.svg` | Vector, 240 × 240 viewBox, chrome directional star         | Replace with your own self-contained SVG using the same filename                    |
| `artwork/vector-core.svg`  | Vector, 1200 × 1200, hero fallback                         | Replace with a self-contained SVG using the same filename                           |
| `artwork/fittrack90.svg`   | Vector, 1200 × 900, concept poster                         | Replace only if you want different concept art; real screenshots belong in `media/` |
| `artwork/vaultledger.svg`  | Vector, 1200 × 900                                         | Same                                                                                |
| `artwork/mindlock.svg`     | Vector, 1200 × 900                                         | Same                                                                                |
| `favicon.svg`              | Vector square brand mark                                   | Replace with your approved vector brand symbol                                      |

Keep the SVGs self-contained with no linked external fonts or images. Regenerate the supplied originals with `node scripts/artwork.mjs`; this deliberately overwrites the files it creates. It is not run automatically by the build, so your replacements survive normal builds.

If you make a raster sticker instead, export a transparent 1024 × 1024 WebP and add it to `public/stickers/`. Change the matching image path in `src/App.jsx` from `.svg` to `.webp`, then rebuild. Do not rename PNG or WebP bytes to `.svg`.

## Optional creative prompts

Orbit seal: “Design a premium circular vector-style seal for Kinetiqs, obsidian background, cobalt blue and soft frost lettering, tiny orbital directional arrows, generous empty center, precise monospace microtype, text MADE OF INTENT / BUILT TO MOVE, no gradients in lettering, isolated transparent background, crisp and simple at small size.”

Chrome sticker: “A single sculptural four-point directional star, iridescent chrome, broad polished surfaces, cobalt reflections on one edge and a restrained warm amber reflection on the other, asymmetric engineering-studio object, isolated transparent background, no words, no mockup, frontal three-quarter view, clean silhouette.”

Logo: “Create an original minimal Kinetiqs identity: an engineered K symbol built from two decisive directional vectors, balanced negative space, confident compact silhouette, luxury independent software studio, cobalt #0052FF and frost on obsidian #050508, flat vector geometry, no bevel, no stock circuit motif, show a symbol-only option and a lowercase kinetiqs wordmark with meticulous optical spacing.”

The website already includes a working original mark. To install a new approved mark, replace the inline `Mark` component in `src/App.jsx` and the favicon. Your previously supplied PNG logos remain preserved in the source `assets/` folder.
